title: Weather Forecast Quality
description: Analysis of Open-Meteo forecast accuracy against Meteostat observations

list.name: city
list.label: Город
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, location_id AS __value FROM dm.dim_locations ORDER BY name
list.definition: SELECT name AS __text, location_id AS __value FROM dm.dim_locations ORDER BY name

panels.title: MAE и RMSE температуры по горизонту

targets.rawSql:
SELECT LPAD(horizon_hours::TEXT, 3, '0') || ' ч' AS "Горизонт",
ROUND(AVG(ABS(temperature_error_c::NUMERIC)), 3)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS "MAE",
ROUND(SQRT(AVG(POWER(temperature_error_c::NUMERIC, 2))), 3)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS "RMSE"
FROM dm.fact_forecast_accuracy
WHERE location_id = ${city:sqlstring}
  AND $__timeFilter(forecast_for)
  AND temperature_error_c IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY horizon_hours
ORDER BY horizon_hours

SELECT LPAD(horizon_hours::TEXT, 3, '0') || ' ч' AS "Горизонт",
ROUND(AVG(temperature_error_c::NUMERIC), 3)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS "Bias"
FROM dm.fact_forecast_accuracy
WHERE location_id = ${city:sqlstring}
  AND $__timeFilter(forecast_for)
  AND temperature_error_c IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY horizon_hours
ORDER BY horizon_hours

panels.title: Покрытие прогнозов наблюдениями
panels.description: Percentage of elapsed forecast hours with an actual temperature measurement

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE temperature_actual_c IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS coverage_pct
FROM dm.fact_forecast_accuracy
WHERE location_id = ${city:sqlstring}
  AND $__timeFilter(forecast_for)
  AND forecast_for <= NOW()

WITH ranked_forecasts AS (
    SELECT
        forecast_for AS time,
        temperature_forecast_c,
        temperature_actual_c,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY forecast_for
            ORDER BY collected_at DESC, snapshot_id DESC
        ) AS forecast_rank
    FROM dm.fact_forecast_accuracy
    WHERE location_id = ${city:sqlstring}
      AND $__timeFilter(forecast_for)
      AND collected_at <= forecast_for - INTERVAL '1 hour'
)
SELECT
    time,
    temperature_forecast_c::DOUBLE PRECISION AS "Прогноз, °C",
    temperature_actual_c::DOUBLE PRECISION AS "Факт, °C"
FROM ranked_forecasts
WHERE forecast_rank = 1
ORDER BY time
